items.r: أخرجه أهل السنن وأحمد وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 1/ 83
items.en: How perfect my Lord is, The Most High.’

items.t: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
items.en: How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord, and I praise You. O Allah, forgive me.
items.tl: Subḥānaka llāhumma rabbanā wa bi-ḥamdika, allāhumma ighfir lī

items.en: Perfect and Holy He is, Lord of the angles and the Rooh i.e. Jibra-eel.
items.tl: Subwḥun, quddūsun, rabbu l-malāʾikati wa ar-rūḥ

items.t: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَصَوَّرَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ، وَبَصَرَهُ، تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الخَالِقِينَ
items.en: O Allah, unto You I have prostrated and in You I have believed, and unto You I have submitted. My face has prostrated before He Who created it and fashioned it, and brought forth its faculties of hearing and seeing. Blessed is Allah, the Best of creators.
items.tl: Allāhumma laka sajadtu wabika āmantu, walaka aslamtu, sajada wajhiya lilladhī khalaqahu, wa ṣawwarahu, washaqqa samʿahu wa baṣarahu, tabāraka llāhu aḥsnu l-khāliqyn

items.t: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الجَبَرُوتِ وَالمَلَكُوتِ، وَالكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالعَظَمَةِ
items.r: أبو داود 1/ 230 وأحمد، والنسائي، وإسناده حسن
items.en: How perfect He is, The Possessor of total power, sovereignty, magnificence and grandeur.
items.tl: Subḥāna dhī l-jabarūti, wa-l-malakūti, wa-l-kibriyāʾi, wa-l-ʿaẓamah

items.t: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَّتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
items.en: O Allah, forgive me all of my sins, the small and great of them, the first and last of them, and the seen and hidden of them.
items.tl: Allāhumma ighfir lī dhanbī kullahu: diqqahu wa jillahu, wa awwalahu wa ākhirahu, wa ʿalāniyyatahu wa sirrah

items.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لَا أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ
items.en: O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure and within Your pardon from Your punishment, and I take refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise. You are as You have praised Yourself.
items.tl: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bi-riḍāka min sakhaṭika, wa bi-muʿāfātika min ʿuqūbatika, wa aʿūdhu bika minka, lā uḥṣī thanāʾan ʿalayka, anta kamā athnayta ʿalā nafsik
